blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The heat index peaked in Zamboanga City on Monday, Nov. 16, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). Based on its five-day computed heat index, 43°C was recorded in Zamboanga City, Zamboanga del Sur, while 42°C was recorded in Dagupan City, Pangasinan, and Coron, Palawan.
